entities.name: STK4
observations: MST1, also called mammalian sterile 20-like kinase 1, was studied through overexpression and knockout in diabetic mice.

entities.name: Diabetic cardiomyopathy
observations: In mice, MST1 overexpression worsened cardiac dysfunction, suppressed autophagy-associated measures, and increased cardiomyocyte apoptosis; MST1 loss enhanced autophagy-associated measures and reduced apoptosis.

entities.name: PMID:27510910
observations: MST1 coordinately regulates autophagy and apoptosis in diabetic cardiomyopathy in mice. Diabetologia, 2016.
